newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest says hedges 3.7 mln/oz gold.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest says hedges 3.7 mln/oz gold.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Thursday it has hedged more than 3.7 million ounces of gold in forward sales and options positions.
The hedging covers both U.S. and Australian dollar denominated forward sales and options, Newcrest said.
In U.S. dollars, 100,000 ounces has been hedged annually for nine years, starting in 1997/98 (July-June), the company said.
The values of the positions increase from US$472 an ounce to over US$500 an ounce in the latter years, it said.
The average in U.S. dollars is $490 an ounce, Newcrest said.

Australian dollar forward sales of 240,000 ounces covering the financial years from 1998/99 to 2002/03 have a final payout value which depends of the Australian dollar spot price of gold at maturity, the company said.
The final price can vary substantially depending on the spot price, Newcrest said.
"Assuming that gold trades within its range of the last eight years, this hedge will deliver values that would average in excess of A$1,200 an ounce," it said.
In put options, 660,000 ounces averaging US$463 an ounce have been spread over 6.5 years starting in 1997/98, Newcrest said.
Australian dollar put options average A$900 and cover 200,000 ounces a year for six years starting in 2003, the company said.
Newcrest said the balance of its current year gold production was fully hedged.
Newcrest said it was issuing details of its hedging book in reponse to recent developments in gold bullion markets and press reports.
Bullion prices of around US$355.60 an ounce are the lowest in over three years.
Newcrest, which unwound 2.0 million ounces in forward hedge positions in August, denied at the time it was abandoned the strategy.
